scheme_name: CBSE Skill Education Lab Setup Scheme
overview: The CBSE Skill Education Lab Setup Scheme is a government initiative aimed at establishing skill education laboratories in schools affiliated with the Central Board of Secondary Education (CBSE). The scheme focuses on integrating vocational and skill-based learning into the school curriculum to enhance employable skills among students. It supports the implementation of the National Education Policy (NEP) 2020 by promoting experiential learning and industry-aligned training in emerging sectors.
objectives: To establish skill education laboratories in CBSE-affiliated schools
To promote vocational training and skill development aligned with industry needs
To support the implementation of the National Education Policy 2020
To enhance employability and entrepreneurship among students
To provide hands-on learning experiences in emerging sectors
To bridge the gap between academic education and practical skills
To train teachers in delivering skill-based education effectively
eligibility: CBSE-affiliated schools are eligible to apply for the Skill Education, provided they meet infrastructure and administrative approval process.
benefits: Financial support for setting up skill labs, access to standardized curriculum and training modules, teacher training programs, industry partnerships for internships and placements, enhanced student engagement and learning outcomes, alignment with NEP 2020 goals, and improved school infrastructure for vocational education.
financial_support: The scheme provides financial assistance to eligible schools for the establishment of skill education laboratories, including procurement of equipment, setup of infrastructure, and training of personnel. The exact quantum and mechanism of support are determined based on the proposal and availability of funds under the scheme guidelines.
application_process: 1. Schools must log in to the CBSE portal or designated skill education portal. 2. Submit a proposal detailing the lab setup, objectives, budget, and implementation plan. 3. Upload required documents such as school affiliation certificate, infrastructure details, and financial plan. 4. Await review and approval by the CBSE Skill Education Committee. 5. Upon approval, receive sanction letter and proceed with lab establishment. 6. Submit utilization reports and completion certificate after implementation.
required_documents: Infrastructure details and layout plan of the proposed lab
Budget estimate for equipment and setup
Details of proposed skill courses to be offered
deadlines: Rolling basis — applications are accepted throughout the year subject to availability of funds and approval cycles.
implementing_agency: Central Board of Secondary Education (CBSE), Ministry of Education, Government of India
caveats: Funds are subject to availability and approval by the competent authority
Lab setup must comply with CBSE skill education guidelines and safety standards
Utilization of funds must be audited and reported as per financial norms
The scheme may be revised or discontinued based on policy updates
